title: 05. Two Eyes & Life/Death (22k–19k)
description: A group needs two separate eyes to live permanently. Find the vital point to make two eyes or destroy the opponent's eyes.

puzzles.title: Make Two Eyes on the Edge
puzzles.prompt: Black's corner group is surrounded by White. Play the vital point inside to split the space into two separate eyes.

solutions.feedback: Alive! B1 divides your inner pocket into two separate single-point eyes at A1 and B2—White can never legally capture this group.
Alive! B2 divides your inner pocket into two separate eyes at A2 and B1.

wrongHints.default: Play in the middle of your 3-space pocket (B1 or B2) so it splits into two separate eyes that White cannot fill simultaneously.

puzzles.title: Kill the Opponent's Eye Shape
puzzles.prompt: White's corner group has a 3-space eye pocket. Strike the vital point before White makes two eyes!

solutions.feedback: Vital point! Occupying H8 reduces White to at most one eye—the entire corner group is dead.

wrongHints.default: The enemy's vital point is my vital point: play at H8 right in the center of White's 3-point eye space.
